{{Quote|There's never been a war we haven't fought in.|The Mandalorian chieftain|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
A '''Mandalorian chieftain''' was present during a meeting of numerous [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan [[Chief/Legends|chiefs]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and company [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|heads]] with [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Gathered at [[MandalMotors Hall]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the chieftain opened the meeting with the question of who the Mandalorians would be fighting for in the growing [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the fledgling [[Confederation]].

==History==
{{Quote|This isn't our fight. Mandalore's got its own troubles.''"<br />"''The war's escalating. Their troubles might come and find ''us.|Boba Fett and the Mandalorian chieftain|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], this [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] came to become the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of his clan at some point prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. That year, he gathered with a number of other chieftains, clan leaders, and Mandalorian company [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEOs]] at a meeting of the clans held in [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], at [[MandalMotors Hall]]. There, in addition to the other clan leaders and numerous other Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and any other Mandalorian who had been interested in attending, he questioned reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] as to what role the Mandalorians would take in the [[Second Galactic Civil War|growing conflict]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Confederation]]. The chieftain believed that the Mandalorians should be involved, fighting on one side or the other&mdash;though he asserted no preference for either government&mdash;if for no other reason than because they always had some part in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] warfare throughout history. When Fett suggested that Mandalore stay out of the war, the chieftain warned that the war may end up coming unwillingly to them.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

The chieftain was later drawn into a discussion with the gathered clan leaders and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] when [[Neth Bralor]] suggested Mandalore look after itself and focus on rebuilding in the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. [[Standard minute/Legends|Minutes]] later, when the Mandalorian known as [[Graad]]&mdash;an avid supporter of the ''[[kadikla]]'' movement&mdash;suggested that Fett should recall a number of Mandalorians from diaspora throughout the galaxy, the chieftain and nearly all of the assembled Mandalorians looked to Fett for his response, one that would come in favor of Graad's suggestion. Soon after, the meeting broke up and the chieftain departed MandalMotors hall with the other assembled clan leaders.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|So, ''Mand'alor'', are we going to fight or what?|The chieftain|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
The Mandalorian chieftain believed that the Mandalorians' place was fighting in the galaxy's wars, and he appeared to be proud of their legacy of being a presence in every major war in history. He was a [[Politics/Legends|politically]] wary man, as well, unconvinced that if Mandalore declared itself neutral of the rising [[Second Galactic Civil War|civil war]], it would be enough to keep them from being caught up in the hostilities.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

Physically, the chieftain possessed a beard which he shaved in an ornate fashion, and an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] that he wore over one [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed Mandalorian chieftain made his first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', the fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. Written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], the novel was published [[May 29]], [[2007]].
